title: Security
subtitle: Your two-step sign-in, recovery codes and signed-in devices.

idle.warnBody: You will be signed out in one minute because nothing happened for a while.
idle.expired: You were signed out because nothing happened for 30 minutes. Sign in again.

wizard.title: Set up two-step sign-in
wizard.startAgainBody: Sign in again and we will take you back to set-up.
wizard.codeHint: Open the authenticator app, find this account and type the code it shows.
wizard.wrongCode: Code did not match, use the new 30-second code.
wizard.slowDown: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.
wizard.generic: Two-step sign-in could not be turned on. Try again.
wizard.ackNeeded: Tick "I saved them" before you finish.

authenticator.title: Add an authenticator app
authenticator.descriptionDesktop: 1. Scan this picture with your authenticator app. 2. Type the 6-digit code it shows.
authenticator.descriptionPhone: 1. Open your authenticator app with the button. 2. Type the 6-digit code it shows.
authenticator.qrAlt: QR picture to scan with your authenticator app
authenticator.qrError: The picture could not be drawn. Type the key below into your app.
authenticator.manualKey: Or type this key into your app

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe. They are shown only now.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.onBody: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.offBody: Add an authenticator app so a stolen password alone cannot get in.
twoStep.loadError: We could not read your two-step status.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.none: You have no recovery codes left.
codes.makeBody: New codes replace the old ones. The old codes stop working.
codes.confirmBody: The old codes stop working. You confirm with a code next.
codes.error: New codes could not be made. Try again.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.description: Devices where you are signed in now. Sign out any you do not know.
devices.error: We could not load your devices.
devices.revokeError: That device could not be signed out. Try again.
devices.signOutAllFailed: Some devices could not be reached and may still be signed in. Sign out everywhere again.

twoStep.title: What is two-step sign-in?
twoStep.body: After your password, you type a 6-digit code from an app on your phone. A thief with only your password cannot get in.

codes.title: What are recovery codes?
codes.body: Ten one-time codes for the day you lose your phone. Each works once. Making new codes cancels the old ones.

devices.title: What are signed-in devices?
devices.body: Every phone or computer where you are signed in. Sign out a device you do not know, or sign out everywhere.
